interfaces.name: IRGenerator::generate
interfaces.contract: Transforms validated AST statements into a linear t81::tisc::ir::IntermediateProgram.
interfaces.error_handling: Throws t81::frontend::CompileError on malformed AST nodes
interfaces.determinism_requirements: Deterministic symbol resolution and label indexing

interfaces.name: IVirtualMachine::step
interfaces.contract: Executes exactly one TISC instruction in the current active context, checking Axion policy before side effects.
interfaces.error_handling: Returns std::unexpected(Trap) on faults or policy denials
interfaces.determinism_requirements: Bit-exact state progression, no unseeded randomness or unmapped system time

interfaces.name: T81Limb27::operator*
interfaces.contract: Computes exact balanced ternary product of two 27-trit limbs, normalized to 54 trits.

interfaces.name: T81BigInt::operator+
interfaces.contract: Arbitrary precision balanced ternary addition preserving non-negative limb magnitude invariants.
interfaces.determinism_requirements: Bit-exact multi-limb borrow and carry propagation

interfaces.name: PolicyEngine::evaluate
interfaces.contract: Evaluates mandatory ethical principles Theta-1..9 and user policy bytecode against system calls.
interfaces.inputs: SyscallContext containing caller, opcode, memory segment, and arguments
interfaces.error_handling: Fails closed returning VerdictKind::Deny with descriptive reason
interfaces.determinism_requirements: Bit-exact decision replay across all platforms

interfaces.name: PersistentDriver::write_object
interfaces.contract: Stores payload under immutable SHA-256 digest with portable hex filename (objects/h1-<hash>.blk).
interfaces.inputs: ObjectType tag and raw byte span
interfaces.error_handling: Returns Result error code on I/O failure or permission error
interfaces.determinism_requirements: Bit-exact canonical hash generation and fail-closed integrity verification
